notes: Live UK storefront (custom platform, not Shopify/SFCC-branded). Direct curl_cffi fetch worked for every URL, no WAF encountered. Category tree sourced from uk/sitemap_Category.xml. KEY TECHNIQUE: each category page's raw HTML embeds a server-rendered 'initialItems': JSON.parse('[...]') blob (page 0 of the grid) with per-product category_id tags. Page size cap is 48; when the embedded array has <48 items this is the complete, exact total (verified against WebFetch's rendered 'Showing X of X' text for Candle Holders 24/24, Lighting 31/31, Mirrors 10/10). Only Tableware hit the 48-item SSR cap; its true total (56) came from WebFetch's rendered 'Showing 48 of 56' text. RULE 0.6 OVERLAP: Candle Holders (24, own listing) and Candle Lanterns (1, its own nav-exposed sub-URL) overlap; likewise Lighting (31, own listing) overlaps with its sub-URLs Ceiling Lights (5) and Table Lamps (6) -- emitted all as siblings per Rule 0.6 rather than nulling the larger real counts. RULE 0 GAIN: kept Outdoor Decorative Accessories (4 items: candle holders/trays) despite the 'Outdoor' room word (Rule 0.5); no dedicated outdoor/bathroom/vanity lighting sub-nodes exist on this site to gain further from Rule 0.1, and no standalone Clocks category exists (checked; the only clock-shaped URL 'alarm-cs' resolves empty). EXCLUDED: Kitchen Accessories (34 items, majority Le Creuset cookware, cutlery sets, tea towels, oven gloves -- functional, not decor); Picnicware (20 items, picnic glasses/melamine/coolware -- functional outdoor dining ware, overlaps Glassware); Bathroom Accessories (35 items, majority toothbrush holders/soap dishes/dispensers/tissue-box covers/laundry baskets -- bathroom hardware & storage per Rule 0.4); Table Linen & Accessories and Laundry & Storage (textile/storage); all Home-Fragrance nodes (candles, diffusers, home sprays, reed diffusers, aromatherapy oils -- Home Fragrance exclusion); Furniture, Bedroom, Rugs, Cushions, Beanbags, Throws (furniture/textile exclusion); Clothing, Baby & Children, Beauty & Spa, Gifts, Christmas/Seasonal (out of scope departments). Checked and dropped every 'Home-Collections/*' node (fine-silver/mother-of-pearl/fine-wood Frame Collections, Porto/Artisan/Portobello Stoneware Collections, Symons Bone China Collection, Chiltern Mirrors Collection, White Lacquer Collection, The Sharing Board, Le Creuset) -- each is a tiny (0-9 item) 'Collections' facet page whose product_id/category_id tags prove it is a 100% subset of the already-kept Photo Frames, Tableware, or Mirrors leaf nodes (Le Creuset itself is cookware, excluded outright). Also dropped a broken duplicate URL 'uk/c/Decorative-Accessories' (returns 0 items; the real, working node is Home/Home-Accessories/c/decorative-accessories, kept). Decorative Accessories (34) is the site's own genuine node but its grid includes a minority of dried-floral wreaths/branches (~5 of its 18 directly-tagged items) that would normally be excluded as botanical decor if they had their own node -- reported as-is per 'qty = website's own reported number for the URL', overlap documented here rather than hand-edited.
